full_prompt_en: A square, densely colored oil-like painting shows a bearded man and a woman seated close together before an intricate field of warm golden decoration. The background fills the upper part of the frame with interwoven orange, yellow, muted turquoise, and gray-blue marks. Its layered pattern suggests foliage and ornamental shapes, but it remains more important as a textured color tapestry than as a sharply defined setting. A broad golden sofa or upholstered seat runs behind and beneath the pair, linking the figures to the patterned ground. On the left, the man faces outward with a composed, slightly tired expression. His short dark hair, dark moustache, and gray-black beard frame a pale face warmed with rose on the cheeks. A black jacket encloses his upper body, opening to a muted ochre vest and dark neckwear; his arms cross low over his lap and brown trouser legs angle into the lower left corner. On the right, the woman turns slightly toward the left with her gaze lowered and her fingers resting lightly beneath her chin. Her dark brown hair gathers into a soft, broad shape around the head. A dark dress with delicate pale trimming at the neck and cuffs surrounds her light face and hands, while a broad patch of golden fabric spreads across her lap. The two dark-clothed figures are distinct against the luminous orange seat and the flickering decorative background, yet the many small brush marks link every surface. Paint lies in broken, closely set strokes, so skin appears comparatively smooth while fabric and surrounding color shimmer with irregular texture. Warm, diffused light brightens the faces and golden areas without producing a hard cast shadow. The overall composition makes an intimate double portrait through the meeting of still poses, deep dark clothing, and a vibrant, enveloping tapestry of color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、色彩密集而近似油画的作品，在暖金色繁复装饰前呈现并肩而坐的留胡子男子与女子。背景占满画面上部，由橙、黄、低饱和青绿和灰蓝笔痕交织而成。层叠花纹让人联想到叶丛与装饰形体，但它作为富于肌理的色彩织毯，比作为清晰场所更重要。一张宽阔的金黄色沙发或软垫座椅从两人身后和下方延伸，把他们与有花纹的背景连接起来。左侧男子面朝画外，神情平静而略带倦意。短黑发、深色八字胡和灰黑胡须围住浅色面孔，双颊带一点玫瑰红。黑色外套包住上身，露出低饱和赭黄背心和深色领饰；双臂在腿上低低交叠，棕色裤腿斜向左下角。右侧女子略向左转，垂下目光，手指轻轻托在下巴下面。深棕头发在头部周围聚成柔和宽阔的形。深色连衣裙在领口与袖口带精细的浅色镶边，围住她浅色的脸和手；一大片金色布料铺在膝上。两位深色衣着的人物在发亮的橙色座面和闪动的装饰背景前清楚分开，但众多小笔触又把各种表面连在一起。颜料以密集而断续的笔痕铺陈，皮肤相对平滑，衣物和周围色彩则闪着不规则的肌理。温暖的漫射光照亮面孔与金色区域，没有形成生硬的投影。整体构图以静止的姿态、深色衣服与活跃包围的色彩织毯交会，形成亲密的双人肖像。
style_prompt_en: The painting builds a dense, intimate surface from broken, closely spaced brush marks and broad color fields that seem to vibrate internally. Warm yellow, orange, and ochre occupy much of the image, while muted turquoise, gray-blue, rose, and almost-black interrupt the warmth with carefully measured contrast. Darker masses hold a focal area against an ornate, high-activity field, yet their edges remain softened by neighboring strokes and shared pigment. Fine patterns and flickering flecks keep even flat areas visually active. Light appears warm and diffused, emerging from the color relationships rather than sharp cast shadows. Compressed depth brings the near and far planes into close conversation, and the composition feels enveloping, decorative, and quietly observant.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画以断续而密集的笔触及内部似乎不断闪动的大色域，建立稠密而亲近的表面。暖黄、橙与赭色占据画面大部，低饱和青绿、灰蓝、玫瑰红和近黑色以精心控制的反差打断暖意。深色块在华丽、活动量很高的色域前稳住焦点，但它们的边缘又被相邻笔痕和共用颜料柔化。细密花纹与闪动的色点让平坦区域也保持视觉活力。光线温暖而漫射，更像从色彩关系中浮现，而非来自清晰的投影。压缩的纵深让近景与远景彼此贴近，构图呈现包围感、装饰感与安静的观察气质。
theme_en: A seated bearded man and a woman on a patterned golden sofa
theme_zh: 一位留胡子的男子与一位女子坐在有花纹的金黄色沙发上
name: Pierre Bonnard
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
